compose_two_graphs: compose two GTN graphs using gtn.compose to chain transducer automata together
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a GTN graph using gtn.forward_score for log-sum-exp scoring
find_viterbi_path: find the highest-scoring path through a GTN graph using gtn.viterbi_path for decoding
union_multiple_graphs: union multiple GTN graphs into one using gtn.union to combine alternative automata
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a GTN graph using gtn.remove to simplify the automaton
